claims.question: Which CVEs describe the Argo CD ServerSideDiff Secret leak, and what is the actual patched floor?
claims.skill_answer: CVE-2026-42880 (critical) was patched in v3.3.9 / v3.2.11, but that fix was incomplete: CVE-2026-45737 lists 3.3.9 and 3.4.1 as affected. The real floor is v3.4.2 / v3.3.10 / v3.2.12.
